errors.evidence: The description states that the y-axis interval is 0.01, but the axis labels (0.00, 0.02, 0.04, etc.) clearly show an interval of 0.02.

The list of bar values is highly inaccurate. For example, the bar at position 2 has a value of approximately 0.15 (not 0.10), the bar at position 3 has a value of approximately 0.158 (not 0.10), and the bar at position 4 has a value of approximately 0.13 (not 0.10). Most of the reported values are incorrect.

The prompt asks to include the shortest and longest bars and any consistent trends. The description fails to identify the longest bar (at position 3, with a value of ~0.158) and the shortest bar (at position 11, with a value of ~0.022). It also omits the general trend, which is that the proportion peaks early (at position 3) and then generally decreases.
The prompt asks to describe the bars including their color. The description does not mention that the bars are blue.
The phrase '见名副实的排序' is awkward and unnatural phrasing in this context to mean 'there is no sorting'.
